oss_reference.retrieval: ref/sailfish_src (sha256 pinned in ref/provenance.json); formulas re-derived symbolically by derive_oss_pressure_tensor.py, never transcribed by hand

decision: Adopt the OSS pressure-tensor-equilibrium recipe as the TensorLBM route for measuring mechanical pressure / surface tension directly from the populations, or keep the existing explicit-Korteweg-force route and measure pressure post hoc.
alternatives: A_oss_transplant: equilibrium carries the free-energy pressure tensor (sailfish recipe); pressure read as sum_i f_i c_ia c_ib - rho u_a u_b
B_tl_force: standard BGK equilibrium + explicit Korteweg force mu grad(phi) (TensorLBM phasefield route); pressure read as cs^2 rho
hypothesis: The OSS equilibrium reproduces the continuum free-energy pressure tensor exactly (machine-precision second-moment closure), and the pressure read off the populations then reproduces surface tension and the normal-stress flatness condition while the force-based route cannot expose a mechanical pressure at all.

metrics.closure_residual: max_ab |sum_i f_i^eq c_ia c_ib - (P_ab + rho u_a u_b)| (absolute, lattice units)
metrics.sigma_rel_error: (sigma_measured - (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A)) / (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A)
metrics.dpnn_residual: max |d P_NN / dn| over the bulk region (mechanical equilibrium => 0)
metrics.spurious_speed: max |u| after N BGK steps with frozen phi
metrics.order_param_closure: |sum_i g_i - phi| and |sum_i g_i c_ix - phi u_x|

baseline_control.A_oss_transplant: analytic closed forms of the same free-energy functional: sigma = (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A), xi = sqrt(2 kappa / A), P_NN = const, and the symbolic identity from derive_oss_pressure_tensor.py (independent of the torch implementation)
baseline_control.B_tl_force: same fields, same operators, same measurement functions -- the only changed variable is where the Korteweg stress lives (equilibrium vs force term)

predeclared_thresholds.verdict_rule: G1 closure + G2 sigma(<15%) + G3 order-parameter closure must pass for the transplant to be accepted as OSS-consistent; G2 is evaluated on the resolved-interface subset xi >= 2 (xi = 1 is recorded as an under-resolution failure mode, not as a pass)
predeclared_thresholds.note: Thresholds follow the owner precision standard (15% unacceptable above) and machine-precision algebra (1e-12); they were fixed before the sweep. No threshold was relaxed after seeing results.

confounders: interface under-resolution (xi < 2) biases sigma low -- separated by the xi sweep instead of being averaged away
radial binning of the droplet profile adds O(1/R) noise to sigma -- separated by the R sweep
frozen phi (quench) removes Cahn-Hilliard transport, so none of the above measures the phi-transport accuracy

sensitivity_plan: xi sweep at fixed A: xi in {1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4} -> sigma error vs resolution (convergence)
R sweep at fixed xi: R in {10, 12, 16, 24} -> curvature effect on sigma error
tau sweep at fixed xi, R: tau in {0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5} -> spurious current / stability of the transplanted equilibrium
A sweep at fixed xi: A in {0.05, 0.1, 0.2} -> sigma scaling vs sqrt(A)
repetition_rationale: The experiment is deterministic (fixed fields, no randomness, float64 CPU): repetition is unnecessary, and instead the parameter axes above are swept so that the reported error is a function of resolution/curvature rather than a single number.
analysis_plan: Report every point (no outlier removal). sigma error sign convention negative = measured below analytic. Aggregation: per-run values; the sweep summary quotes the resolved-interface subset. Uncertainty: the xi -sweep gives the discretisation trend; no statistical error bars are claimed for a deterministic scheme.
environment: python 3, torch CPU float64, numpy, sympy, matplotlib; reproducible with `python xval/XVAL-LBM-PRESSURE-TENSOR-EQUILIBRIUM-TRANSPLANT/run_xval.py`
safety_resource_limits: no cluster job needed: the whole sweep is <10 s of CPU; no file outside the worktree is written except /tmp report payloads
interpretation_limits: only the D2Q9 branch of the OSS model is transplanted (D3Q19 branch differs only in the wxx/wyy/wzz/wxy/wxz/wyz tables; not exercised here)
quench (frozen phi) tests the *equilibrium* semantics only; phi transport (g-population collision rate Gamma) is out of scope and recorded as such
dp_bulk is identically zero for the symmetric double well: the Laplace law is *not* testable as a bulk pressure jump in this model variant, so no Laplace percentage is claimed
